name: 国际投资与跨国公司【英】

goals: Discuss basic concepts, conceptual frameworks, and some broader contexts of international investment & transnational corporations
Analyze and discuss examples of international investment & transnational corporations
Develop an understanding of the strategies of international investment & transnational corporations.
outline.intro: International investment is a kind of economic behavior that investors transform their own money capital and industrial capital into physical assets, intangible assets or financial assets by transnational flow, and achieve added value through transnational business. The main body of international investment is transnational corporation. This course can be divided into 3 parts: the first is the knowledge of international investment and transnational corporation theory, the second part is the knowledge of transnational corporations management, the third part is international investment management.
outline.objectives: International Investment & Transnational Corporations is one compulsory course for the undergraduate major of international economy and trade. The task of the course is to combine international investment & transnational corporation theory with international investment & transnational corporations practice. The course introduces the basic knowledge and skills of international investment & transnational corporation, cultivates and improves the students" ability to solve problems of international investment & transnational corporation activities, so that after graduation they can better adapt to the international investment & transnational corporation practice and management. After completion of the course students should learn how to write clearly and concisely, learn effectively, think critically and creatively, and work productively.
